You are an expert contract lawyer who classifies clauses from commercial contracts.

Classify the contract clause below into exactly one of these 27 categories:
- Anti-Assignment: consent or notice is required if the contract is assigned to a third party.
- Audit Rights: a party may audit the books, records or premises of the other party to check compliance.
- Cap On Liability: liability for breach is capped, or the time to bring claims is limited.
- Change Of Control: a party may terminate, or consent/notice is required, if the other party undergoes a merger, acquisition or other change of control.
- Competitive Restriction Exception: an exception or carve-out to a non-compete, exclusivity or no-solicit restriction.
- Covenant Not To Sue: a party may not contest the other party's IP ownership or bring certain claims against it.
- Exclusivity: an exclusive dealing commitment, e.g. buying all requirements from one party or not selling to others.
- Expiration Date: the date or period at which the initial term of the contract ends.
- Governing Law: which state's or country's law governs the contract.
- Insurance: a party must maintain insurance for the benefit of the other party.
- Ip Ownership Assignment: intellectual property created by one party becomes the property of the other party.
- Joint Ip Ownership: intellectual property is jointly or co-owned by the parties.
- License Grant: one party grants the other a license (e.g. to use, make or sell) to its IP or products.
- Liquidated Damages: a fixed amount (liquidated damages) or a termination fee is payable on breach or termination.
- Minimum Commitment: a minimum order, quantity, amount or number of units must be bought per period.
- No-Solicit Of Employees: a party may not solicit or hire the other party's employees or contractors.
- Non-Compete: a party may not compete with the other party or operate in a certain field or territory.
- Non-Disparagement: a party must not disparage or speak negatively about the other party.
- Non-Transferable License: the licensee may not transfer, assign or sublicense the license granted.
- Post-Termination Services: obligations that continue after termination or expiry (transition, wind-down, last buy, payments).
- Renewal Term: the contract renews or extends automatically or by notice after the initial term.
- Revenue/Profit Sharing: a party must share revenue or profit (e.g. royalties, a percentage of sales) with the other.
- Rofr/Rofo/Rofn: a right of first refusal, first offer or first negotiation to buy, license or distribute something.
- Source Code Escrow: source code must be deposited with an escrow agent and released on events such as bankruptcy.
- Termination For Convenience: a party may terminate without cause, simply by giving notice.
- Volume Restriction: a fee increase or consent is required if usage exceeds a certain volume or threshold.
- Warranty Duration: how long a warranty against defects or errors lasts.

messages.content: You are an expert contract lawyer who classifies clauses from commercial contracts.

Classify the contract clause below into exactly one of these 27 categories:
- Anti-Assignment
- Audit Rights
- Cap On Liability
- Change Of Control
- Competitive Restriction Exception
- Covenant Not To Sue
- Exclusivity
- Expiration Date
- Governing Law
- Insurance
- Ip Ownership Assignment
- Joint Ip Ownership
- License Grant
- Liquidated Damages
- Minimum Commitment
- No-Solicit Of Employees
- Non-Compete
- Non-Disparagement
- Non-Transferable License
- Post-Termination Services
- Renewal Term
- Revenue/Profit Sharing
- Rofr/Rofo/Rofn
- Source Code Escrow
- Termination For Convenience
- Volume Restriction
- Warranty Duration

Examples (one per category):

Clause: """Neither party may assign this Agreement or any rights and obligations under this Agreement to any third party without the written consent of the other party."""
Category: Anti-Assignment

Clause: """Each Party shall have the right, during normal business hours and upon reasonable notice, to inspect all such records of the other Party, its Affiliates or Permitted Subcontractors."""
Category: Audit Rights

Clause: """EXCEPT IN CONNECTION WITH A BREACH BY EITHER PARTY OF SECTION 8, NEITHER PARTY WILL BE LIABLE FOR ANY SPECIAL, INDIRECT, CONSEQUENTIAL, EXEMPLARY, PUNITIVE OR INCIDENTAL DAMAGES ARISING OUT OF OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT, HOWEVER CAUSED AND UNDER ANY THEORY OF LIABILITY (INCLUDING NEGLIGENCE), EVEN IF SUCH PARTY HAS BEEN ADVISED OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGES"""
Category: Cap On Liability

Clause: """In the event of a change in control of a Party, the other Party shall have the right, upon written prior notice, to terminate this Agreement."""
Category: Change Of Control

Clause: """The Parties acknowledge that nothing in this Agreement shall limit or restrict XENCOR, itself or with or through any third party, from developing and using any process (except for the Process) for the manufacture of any of its products, including the Product, provided that no BII Confidential Information and Know-How is used and XENCOR adheres to its confidentiality and non-use obligations hereunder and complies with the ownership of intellectual property and Improvements as set forth in Section 8 below."""
Category: Competitive Restriction Exception

Clause: """Franchisee shall not at any time during the term of this Agreement or after its termination, contest the validity or ownership of any of the Marks or assist any other person in contesting the validity or ownership of the Marks."""
Category: Covenant Not To Sue

Clause: """The Company appoints the Distributor as an exclusive distributor of Products in the Market, subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement."""
Category: Exclusivity

Clause: """This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and, unless earlier terminated as set out in this Agreement, shall continue for the Term."""
Category: Expiration Date

Clause: """This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York without regard to principles of conflicts of law."""
Category: Governing Law

Clause: """Each Party agrees to obtain and maintain, during the Term and for five (5) years after the Term, commercial general liability insurance, including products liability insurance, with minimum "A-" AM Best rated insurance carriers, in each case with limits of not less than five million dollars ($5,000,000) per occurrence and in the aggregate"""
Category: Insurance

Clause: """To the extent not a work-for- hire, Company, its employees, subcontractors and agents hereby sell, assign and transfer to Reed's all right, title and interest in and to the Work Product, including without limitation, all rights to Intellectual Property therein."""
Category: Ip Ownership Assignment

Clause: """As between the Parties, the Parties shall jointly own all Inventions (including Improvements) developed, conceived or reduced to practice jointly by or on behalf of both Bioeq and Licensee (such Inventions, Joint Inventions, and such Improvements, Joint Improvements), and all Intellectual Property Rights and Know-How therein."""
Category: Joint Ip Ownership

Clause: """Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, the Company hereby grants to Seller a perpetual, non-exclusive, royalty-free license in, to and under the Company Licensed Patents for use in the Arizona Field throughout the world."""
Category: License Grant

Clause: """Customer acknowledges that the Termination Fee is a reasonable approximation of such damages and shall be deemed to be liquidated damages and not a penalty."""
Category: Liquidated Damages

Clause: """In such event, the annual Minimum Royalty during the Renewal Term, if any, shall be equal to the greater of: (a) ***** of the actual Royalty paid to Client in Year 5; and (b) *****."""
Category: Minimum Commitment

Clause: """Both Parties agree that during the Term of this Agreement and for a period of two (2) years following the termination, both Parties will not (i) solicit, encourage, or take any other action, which is intended, directly or indirectly, to induce any employee to terminate his or her employment with a Party; or (ii) interfere in any manner with the contractual or employment relationship between the Parties and any their employees."""
Category: No-Solicit Of Employees

Clause: """During the term of this Agreement, neither Party shall, and shall not permit its Affiliates to, nor grant any rights to any Third Party to, directly or indirectly, Commercialize, or Develop any New Product for Commercialization in the Territory, except as permitted in accordance with this Section 3.4."""
Category: Non-Compete

Clause: """CONSULTANT further agrees that it will not directly or indirectly defame, disparage, or publicly criticize the services, business, integrity, veracity or reputation of the Company or its owners, officers, directors, or employees in any forum or through any medium of communication."""
Category: Non-Disparagement

Clause: """Such reserved non-exclusive license shall be solely for use by the Company and its Affiliates and shall not be transferable to any Third Party, except in connection with a merger, consolidation, or the sale or transfer of substantially all of the Company's assets associated with the performance of this IP Agreement."""
Category: Non-Transferable License

Clause: """Upon the termination or expiration of the term of this Agreement, the parties shall have the following rights and obligations:"""
Category: Post-Termination Services

Clause: """Upon the expiration of such term, this Agreement will renew automatically for successive terms of one (1) year each unless either party to this Agreement delivers written notice of termination to the other party to this Agreement at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the original or any renewal term."""
Category: Renewal Term

Clause: """Vyera shall pay to CytoDyn royalties equal to fifty percent (50%) of Net Sales of Licensed Products in the Territory during the Royalty Term; provided that, after the Step-Down Date, the royalty percentage will be reduced to [***] of Net Sales of Licensed Products in the Territory throughout the remaining period in the Royalty Term."""
Category: Revenue/Profit Sharing

Clause: """If BII does not provide written notice of its exercise of the first right to negotiate within such [...***...] period, XENCOR and any Business Partner shall be free to enter into one or more agreements with third parties for the manufacture and supply of commercial Product (which may include an agreement for any Business Partner or its affiliate to manufacture and supply commercial Product)."""
Category: Rofr/Rofo/Rofn

Clause: """If a Release Condition (as defined in Section 12.2 of this Agreement) occurs and the Escrow Agent provides the Source Code to Corio under the escrow agreement, Corio agrees to hold the Source Code in strict confidence, and not to use the Source Code for any purpose other than those purposes set forth under Section 12.3 of this Agreement."""
Category: Source Code Escrow

Clause: """Either party may terminate this Agreement at any time on prior written notice to the other."""
Category: Termination For Convenience

Clause: """The foregoing obligations of Wildform, following the initial thirty (30) day period, shall be limited to a maximum of thirty (30) hours, or up to a maximum of two hundred (200) emails, whichever accumulates first."""
Category: Volume Restriction

Clause: """NETGEAR warrants to end-user that each item of Hardware will be free from defects in workmanship and materials for its respective warranty period which begins on the date of purchase by the end user. Should a Product fail within this warranty period, Distributor shall replace such defective Product from Distributor's inventory and accept return of the failed Product from Distributor's customer."""
Category: Warranty Duration
